name: Module 7H (Fab 7 extension)
summary: An extension of GlobalFoundries' 300 mm Fab 7 operations in Singapore. Ground was broken in 2021, the first tool moved in in June 2022, and Singapore's Economic Development Board marked the official opening of the US$4 billion expansion fab in September 2023, citing more than 23,000 square metres of cleanroom and 1,000 new jobs. Module 7H began limited production that month and started commercial wafer shipments in the second half of 2024. It is expected to add about 450,000 wafers a year, taking GlobalFoundries' Singapore capacity to about 1.5 million.

metrics.note: Given at the opening as US$4 billion (S$5 billion).
300 mm wafers per year once fully ramped, added to GlobalFoundries' Singapore capacity.
New jobs, mostly equipment and process technicians and engineers.

milestones.note: Official opening of the expansion fab.
GlobalFoundries reports that Module 7H began commercial shipments of wafers in the second half of 2024.

notes: The Economic Development Board release does not use the Module 7H name; it is matched to the module by its September 2023 opening and its 450,000-wafer capacity, which GlobalFoundries' filings give for Module 7H. The cited sources do not name the technologies it runs.
